atomicity.reason: One obligation (report unconfirmed on acknowledgement timeout); the second sentence only clarifies the same timer rather than adding an independent obligation.

comprehensibility.reason: Setpoint frame, acknowledgement frame and request identifier are all introduced within the sentence, so the obligation reads on its own.

feasibility.reason: A per-request 2 s timeout on a frame-based actuator dialogue is standard practice and contradicts nothing else in the set.

parent_fit.reason: ARCH_COOLANT_ACTUATOR_IF names a 2 s acknowledgement timer per raised request that turns silence into an unconfirmed verdict; this requirement specifies exactly that timer and its matching-identifier rule.

unambiguity.reason: The raise condition has one reading, but nothing says whether the unconfirmed verdict latches or clears (e.g. on a late matching acknowledgement or a new request), so downstream behaviour has two readings.
unambiguity.suggestion: Add the clearing condition explicitly, as the sibling requirements do (SWREQ_CURRENT_STALENESS_TIMER states 'clears only on ...'), e.g. 'The unconfirmed report shall clear when a matching acknowledgement is subsequently received' or state that it holds until the next request is raised.

verifiability.reason: Concrete test exists: send a setpoint frame, withhold or mismatch the acknowledgement, assert the unconfirmed report once 2 s have elapsed.

summary: Pins the 2 s acknowledgement timer that ARCH_COOLANT_ACTUATOR_IF explicitly owns; only gap is that the requirement never says when the unconfirmed verdict clears, which SWREQ_LIMIT_MINIMUM depends on.
